facts.fact: The document presents NSDS III 2021-2025 as a final text that the ZIMSTAT Board 'presents for adoption' as the national framework for planning, budgeting and implementing statistical activities; it does not state that it has been adopted, and gives no adoption date (as_of is the document's published date).
The document states NSDS III design was informed by the NSDS II (2016-2020) terminal evaluation, which is stated as completed; no date is given (as_of is the document's published date).
